faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by King George Medical University (KGMU), Lucknow, for an ICMR-DHR funded research project.

faq.question: Q2. What are the total vacancies available under KGMU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 3 vacancies available for various posts including Project Research Scientist-I, Project Technical Support-III, and Project Technical Support-II.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for KGMU various posts?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application via email is 22-10-2026, and the walk-in interview is scheduled for 24-10-2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application mode for KGMU project positions?
faq.answer: Candidates must apply through Email by sending their merged application PDF to [email protected] along with filling out a Google Form.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for Project Research Scientist-I (Medical)?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Project Research Scientist-I (Medical) post will receive a salary of Rs. 67,000/- plus 20% HRA per month.

faq.question: Q6. What educational qualification is required for Project Technical Support-III?
faq.answer: Applicants must hold a three-year Graduate degree in the relevant subject/field with three years of experience, or a Postgraduate degree in Life Sciences.

faq.question: Q7. What is the age limit for Project Technical Support-II?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Project Technical Support-II post is 30 years, as per the official notification guidelines.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee for KGMU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is no application fee specified in the official notification for any of the advertised research and technical support positions.

faq.question: Q9. What are the selection stages for this KGMU notification?
faq.answer: The selection process involves reviewing the email application and Google Form submissions, followed by a personal or walk-in interview.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification and website details?
faq.answer: You can check the official website at www.kgmu.org and refer to the official notification PDF for complete application instructions and guidelines.
